posts.body:
For a long time, almost every personal website I saw followed the same template: giant progress bars for programming languages, corporate buzzwords, and a 'Hire Me' popup.

When I claimed sarojparajuli.com.np from register.com.np, I knew I wanted something warmer and more honest. We are so much more than our 9-to-5 roles. I wanted a place where a friend could listen to an acoustic song I recorded at midnight, read a story from a rainy evening in Kathmandu, watch a vlog, or read my thoughts on a new piece of tech.

Everything on this site is wired to Supabase so as my life evolves, the stories here evolve right along with me.

posts.body:
In this vlog episode, I took my acoustic guitar, a small mirrorless camera, and my notebook up to the terrace just before dusk.

Highlights from the video:
• 00:45 — Tuning to Eb standard for a warmer vocal register
• 02:30 — First live take of 'Chasing Monsoon Clouds'
• 05:15 — Talking about balancing creative hobbies with everyday life

Whenever I upload a new vlog on YouTube or TikTok, I pair it here with the behind-the-scenes story that didn’t fit into the video edit.
posts.title: Vlog #04: Rooftop Acoustic Jam, Golden Hour & Unplugged Conversations
posts.excerpt: Setting up the tripod before sunset, tuning the dreadnought down half a step, and capturing raw takes as the valley lights flicker on.

posts.body:
Every week brings a wave of new tech announcements and AI headlines, but the shift I’m most excited about is how lightweight personal infrastructure has become.

With register.com.np for local identity, Cloudflare handling global DNS and caching, Vercel serving instant edge deployments, and Supabase giving you a full Postgres database with real-time APIs, anyone can run a fast, independent publication without heavy server maintenance.
posts.title: Tech Pulse: Why Edge Databases & Personal Micro-Publishing Are Winning Again
posts.excerpt: A look at how tools like Supabase, Cloudflare, and Vercel make owning your own independent platform simpler and faster than ever.

posts.body:
When you only strum chords, singing over the top feels natural. The moment you switch to fingerpicking an independent bassline, your brain wants to lock your voice to your fingers.

What helped me break through was humming the melody slowly while playing only the root notes on beats 1 and 3, then gradually adding the treble strings back in. Music rewards patience more than almost anything else.
posts.title: The Art of Singing While Playing Fingerstyle Guitar
posts.excerpt: How I trained my thumb to keep a steady bass pulse while letting the vocal phrasing breathe naturally without rushing the tempo.

profile.bio1: I built sarojparajuli.com.np because social feeds move too fast and traditional portfolios feel too robotic. Life is a blend of late-night guitar strumming, conversations over chiya, wondering where technology is taking us, and writing down stories worth remembering.
profile.bio2: Whether I’m learning a new acoustic arrangement, filming a candid vlog, reflecting on a personal milestone, or crafting something thoughtful on the web, this space holds the honest version of my journey.
